channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: RuneScape 4 revealed: Unreal Engine MMO from Jagex
item.description: Jagex announced RuneScape 4 at RuneFest: a standalone Unreal Engine MMO set in the Sixth Age, pivoted from a Dragonwilds survival expansion into a full classic-format MMO.

item.title: Fable keeps combat accessible with hidden complexity
item.description: Playground Games on Fable's combat: accessible but with hidden depth — targeted body-part shots that change enemy behavior, plus non-combat quest paths via dialogue, reputation, and puzzles.

item.title: DwarfStar 4: the Redis guy's narrow local LLM engine
item.description: Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez) shipped ds4, a deliberately narrow C inference engine for a short list of models (DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.x, Qwen 3.8 Flash Next) on Metal/CUDA/ROCm. ~23k stars, MIT licensed.

item.title: llama.cpp in 2026: the engine under every local stack
item.description: llama.cpp primer with an October 3 update: llama-server now serves Jev-style decision models on /v1/systemone, plus notes on Colibri, Hy3 1-bit GGUF, and the engine's 118k-star footprint.

item.title: WoW Forever: Goblin barbers to be replaced in future build
item.description: Blizzard is swapping the beta's Goblin barbers for city-appropriate races (night elves in Darnassus, tauren in Thunder Bluff) after player feedback on the vanilla vibe.

item.title: TensorFold: 2-3x faster local inference, same tokens
item.description: Independent open-source inference engine (Apache-2.0) serving local LLMs behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on Metal/MLX and NVIDIA, claiming 2-3x speedups with byte-identical output.

item.title: POCKET-Darwin-180B: 180B parameters on a laptop
item.description: VIDRAFT released a 4-bit GGUF build of its 180B MoE model that runs on consumer hardware (8GB VRAM + 32GB RAM or CPU-only) via sparse expert routing and graft quantization.

item.title: What's new in Ollama 0.40, and should you upgrade?
item.description: Walkthrough of Ollama 0.40: decision-models API via /v1/systemone (Nimble, Tev1, Cloudflare's Clef), CAPABILITY declarations, and updated llama.cpp/MLX engines.

item.title: WoW Forever beta capacity raised again amid record demand
item.description: Blizzard raised the Forever beta population cap a second time as queues persisted; Josh Greenfield called the demand the biggest he'd seen in 17 years. Beta runs through Oct 21, launch Nov 4.

item.title: On-device voice assistant: STT, LLM, TTS fully offline on Android
item.description: A full voice assistant (STT + LLM + TTS) running entirely offline on a stock Pixel 10: Sherpa-ONNX or ML Kit ASR, MediaPipe/LiteRT or Gemini Nano LLMs, user-switchable models.

item.title: Deploying SLMs: fine-tuning vs context engineering
item.description: When to choose PEFT/LoRA fine-tuning (narrow structured tasks, strict formats, <150ms TTFT on constrained hardware) vs context engineering (fast-changing data, general reasoning), plus hybrid adapter-swap architectures.

item.title: LLM quantization methods: GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF compared
item.description: Practical 2026 defaults: GGUF Q4_K_M for laptop/CPU, AWQ-int4 or GPTQ-int4 for GPU, FP8 for H100/B200, NVFP4/BitNet at the bleeding edge. Benchmarks and when-to-use-what.
